summary: Mobile-only round covering (a) MOBILE participant switcher visibility + switching, (b) MOBILE notifications open + decrement flow, (c) full MOBILE Stripe billing mirror of web iter138/iter148 against the shared backend, and (d) SEO-2 403 regression. Backend pytest: 15 passed, 1 skipped (see notes). Mobile Expo web preview: participant-switcher renders as full-width bar at the very top of the scroll (bbox y=214, height=82) with 'VIEWING CARE FOR Mum' + 'Switch' pill; tapping opens the switch sheet with testID 'participant-option-<id>' options, and selecting Patricia Holloway (Classification 3, Acacia Aged Care) re-scopes the dashboard header to 'Patricia Holloway's care' as expected. Header bell (testID 'header-notifications') opens NotificationsSheet with 30 items, each carrying testID 'notification-item-<id>'; tapping the first item navigates to /statements (the item's link) and the read is POSTed. 'notifications-mark-all-read' is correctly conditionally-rendered only when unread > 0 (verified in /app/mobile/src/components/NotificationsSheet.tsx:38–43); the empty state 'notifications-empty' testID is wired. Stripe checkout returns real cs_test_ URLs for solo AND family for authenticated + guest + free (read-only middleware EXEMPTS /api/payments/); unknown plan rejected 4xx; webhook rejects both missing-signature (400) and bogus-signature (400 'Invalid Stripe signature'); portal/cancel/reactivate correctly return 400 for a user with no Stripe subscription; invoices returns {invoices:[]}. GET /api/billing/subscription and /api/billing/trial-eligibility both 200 with sane payloads. Internal SEO endpoint returns 403 for a wrong X-Internal-Token as required (no external IndexNow ping performed).
critical_code_review_comments: cathy@example.com currently exposes only 2 ACTIVE participants (Mum + Patricia Holloway) in the mobile participant switcher — the credentials note claims 3 (Mum, Robert Kowalski, Patricia Holloway). Robert Kowalski is not shown. Not a UI bug; may be state drift in the seed data. If the intent is 3, the seed script for cathy needs to re-add Robert Kowalski as ACTIVE.

backend/routes/payments.py webhook responds with 'Invalid Stripe signature' (and separately 'Missing Stripe-Signature header' when the header is absent). The problem statement mentions the phrase 'invalid signature' — matches functionally, wording differs. Consider aligning the two error messages if any client-side match relies on the exact 'invalid signature' string.
NotificationsSheet.tsx:38 correctly hides 'Mark all read' when unread==0. Recommend also showing a subtle disabled placeholder or 'You're all caught up' hint to keep the header layout stable.

Read-only middleware exemption for /api/payments/ is confirmed by the free-user checkout test — good, this is the exact behavior needed so free/expired users can start a subscription without hitting a 402.
